# Link Resolution — ambiguous links, broken links, and KB with many pages

# === INIT ===
exec akb init link-kb
cd link-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# === CREATE TWO PAGES WITH SAME BASENAME ===
stdin ../alpha-note.md
exec akb write alpha/shared-name.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/alpha/shared-name.md'

stdin ../beta-note.md
exec akb write beta/shared-name.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/beta/shared-name.md'

# === CREATE SOURCE PAGE WITH AMBIGUOUS AND BROKEN LINKS ===
stdin ../source-note.md
exec akb write source-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/source-note.md'

# === LINKS SHOWS AMBIGUOUS AND BROKEN ===
exec akb links notes/source-note.md
stdout 'Ambiguous:'
stdout 'shared-name'
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout 'nonexistent-page'

# === CREATE MANY PAGES ===
stdin ../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-01.md
stdin ../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-02.md
stdin ../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-03.md
stdin ../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-04.md
stdin ../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-05.md

# === LIST SHOWS ALL PAGES ===
exec akb list
stdout 'notes/page-01.md'
stdout 'notes/page-02.md'
stdout 'notes/page-03.md'
stdout 'notes/page-04.md'
stdout 'notes/page-05.md'

# === STATUS SHOWS CORRECT PAGE COUNT ===
exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 8'

# === SEARCH FINDS PAGES ===
exec akb search 'linktest'
stdout 'notes/source-note.md'

-- alpha-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Alpha Note
summary: First note
tags: linktest
---
Alpha content with [[shared-name]].

-- beta-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Beta Note
summary: Second note
tags: linktest
---
Beta content with [[shared-name]].

-- source-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Source Note
summary: Links to ambiguous target
tags: linktest
---
This links to [[shared-name]] and [[nonexistent-page]].

-- many-pages.md --
---
type: note
title: Many Pages Test
summary: For testing many pages
tags: linktest
---
Page content for bulk test.
